rmt-2004-gen-02.prompt: In the Championship World Series of the future, Rice and Stanford play three games or until one team wins two games. In each game, both teams have a $\frac13$ chance of winning, and there is a $\frac13$ chance that they will tie. What is the probability that Rice wins the championship?
rmt-2004-gen-02.reviewNote: Official key gives 8/23, which counts the 23 game sequences as equally likely although sequences of different lengths have different probabilities; the exact value is 7/27 (= Stanford's chance, with 13/27 of series undecided).

rmt-2004-gen-03.prompt: Find all natural numbers $n$ that satisfy the equation $(n-1)+(n-1)=n!$.

rmt-2004-gen-04.prompt: Find the ordered 4-tuple of positive integers $(a,b,c,d)$ so that $\dfrac{37}{13}=a+\dfrac{1}{b+\dfrac{1}{c+\dfrac1d}}$.

rmt-2004-gen-05.prompt: Each vertex of a given square is the center of one of four circles. The circles are all congruent and each one is tangent to two others. What is the probability that a randomly chosen point in the figure is inside both a circle and the square?
